description_en: Queries the review details of a signature after you submit a signature application
description_zh: 申请签名后，通过此接口查询签名审核详情
name: GetSmsSign

parameters.help_en:
The signature name. The value must be an SMS signature that has been applied for under this account.

Obtain the value from the response parameters after calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807427.html operation.
View the signature on the Signature Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) page
parameters.help_zh:
签名名称。必须是本账号已申请的短信签名。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807427.html接口后在返回参数中获取。
在签名管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)页面查看签名
parameters.name: sign_name
